verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports custom detection rules (regex-based) and can trigger automatic actions on events—pre-commit hook blocks commits containing secrets, and gitleaks-action runs on GitHub push/PR events to alert accounts and comment on PRs. However this is limited to secret-scanning triggers tied to git/CI events, not a general-purpose rule/action automation engine. Missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary event types or custom action definitions beyond GitHub-specific alerting/commenting, and no AI-native/agentic trigger framework.
